Max's favorite animal is the panda. Max bought a coat at the shop yesterday. There are always many people at the bus stop. For example, which airline are you flying with?
Last Friday, Max and Ben went to the train station. Max and Ben had great fun there. They took many photos at the bus stop. The castle is eight hundred years old.
Both of them like noodles and water. Max plays volleyball with Ben every Friday. Life is full of small surprises. Best of all, the bike lane runs beside the river.
Max hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Max learned a lot about art. Max thinks art is interesting but a little difficult.
